questions: Should only desk staff be able to mark an item as claimed (needing some kind of login or password), or can anyone using the board do it?
When people look at a claimed item, should the owner's name be shown to everyone, or kept visible only to the desk?
Should items ever be removed from the board, for example after they are claimed or after a set number of days unclaimed? If so, how long?
answers: No, they stay on the full list, but the list of waiting items should only show unclaimed ones.
